text:
maria: Quick heads-up — scheduled staged rollout for v3.2.1 starts in ~5m (change window 22:00-23:00 UTC). DeployBot preflight looked good but I'm seeing a small latency bump on the canary group in eu-west-1. Thinking we should decide hold at 5% or proceed to 20% after quick check.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary group created (5% traffic) — rollout started.

jamie: telemetry link: https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/1729  p95 up ~18% over baseline since t-3m (tail spike around requests hitting longer seqs)

anil: Errors? 5xxs or model decode failures?

sre-oncall: 5xx rate stable. Not seeing obvious model decode errors, but kv-cache evictions spike on canary pods (eu-west-1) — evict count jumped ~3x at 22:01. Logs show repeated cache miss/evict churn.

maria: Hmm. Could be kvcache thrash for longer inputs. Can we pin the canary to the older quantized variant (v3.2.0-quant) as a quick mitigation and hold traffic increase?

diego: I can push a canary pin now if the team wants. That would swap canary allocation to v3.2.0-quant while we investigate. Quick latency rollback path.

jamie: Vote time — @maria are you asking for a hold? I'm leaning hold until root cause confirmed (cache pressure).

anil: hold. :+1:

jamie: hold. :thumbsup:

diego: Ok I'll pin and stop the percent increase. Pushing pin to canary allocation (eu-west-1) now...

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.2.0-quant on allocation canary-eu-west-1-2. Traffic increase suspended per request by diego.

maria: Thanks. Please watch p95 and mem/eviction metrics for next 10m. If latency normalizes we can reconvene for a cautious bump. Also capture logs for root cause.

sre-oncall: Monitoring update — mem usage stable, kvcache evictions trending down after pin. Will post a 10m snapshot.

jamie: Adding a line for release notes: "Staged rollout temporarily pinned to v3.2.0-quant in eu-west-1 due to elevated latency on v3.2.1 canary; investigating KV cache pressure." Anyone object?

deploy-bot: Reminder: change window ends 23:00 UTC. If pinned, update release notes and rollback playbook.

maria: No objections. I'll update release notes and open a follow-up investigation ticket. If evictions/latency return we escalate.

sre-oncall: Quick log excerpt from canary pod at the spike:```
[22:01:03] kvcache: evict key=seq-4096 shard=3 reason=mem_pressure
[22:01:03] model: serving request id=abcd1234 seq_len=4096 latency=480ms
[22:01:04] kvcache: miss key=seq-4096
```

jamie: Good capture. We'll keep the hold until we confirm stability or find root cause. Reopen this thread for a reconvene in ~10m.
maria: Agreed — thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
